mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wms_item_sku WHERE spu_id = #{mainId} AND is_del = 1 ORDER BY id

SELECT r.final_class FROM wms_abc_class_result r WHERE r.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND r.sku_id = #{skuId} AND r.is_current = 1 AND r.final_class IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.batch_id DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id AS id, s.spu_id AS spuId, s.code AS skuCode, p.sub_title AS spuCode, p.title AS spuName, c.name AS categoryName, p.category_id1 AS categoryId, s.price AS price, p.supplier_id AS supplierId, sup.supplier_name AS supplierName, s.is_sn_managed AS isSnManaged FROM wms_item_sku s INNER JOIN wms_item_spu p ON s.spu_id = p.id AND p.is_del = 1 LEFT JOIN wms_item_category c ON c.id = p.category_id1 AND c.is_del = 1 LEFT JOIN wms_supplier sup ON sup.id = p.supplier_id AND sup.is_del = 1
s.is_del = 1
AND p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{spuName}, '%')
AND (s.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuCode}, '%') OR p.sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{skuCode}, '%'))
AND (p.category_id1 = #{categoryId} OR p.category_id2 = #{categoryId} OR p.category_id3 = #{categoryId})
ORDER BY s.id DESC
